items.text: Raymond James positions its value proposition as a 'best of both worlds' offering: a unique combination of an advisor- and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions, which it says resonates with advisors across all affiliation options.
items.quote: Our best of both worlds value proposition, where we offer a unique combination of an advisor and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions, continues to resonate with advisors across all of our affiliation options.

items.text: The firm states its value proposition, coupled with its strong balance sheet and commitment to independence, is proving to be a differentiator for advisors evaluating alternatives.
items.quote: This value proposition, coupled with our strong balance sheet and commitment to independence, is proving to be a differentiator for advisors evaluating alternatives.

items.text: Raymond James describes a 'powerfully personal' value proposition focused on personal relationships with financial advisors and giving them tools and resources to strengthen their client relationships, in contrast to competitors it says focus on 'IRRs and exit periods.'
items.quote: The powerfully personal, the value proposition that we released with our annual report, several weeks ago, is increasingly differentiating as well. You know, other firms are talking about IRRs and exit periods in three to five years, or funnels and all sorts of impersonal things.

items.text: Raymond James states that 100% of what it pays in transition assistance goes to advisor retention rather than to a seller, contrasting one-by-one recruiting with acquisitions.
items.quote: we'd much rather recruit one by one, where we know the advisors are a good cultural fit, and 100% of what we pay in transition assistance is going to retention versus the seller.

items.text: The firm says it does not lead with the highest check but offers competitive economics while leading with culture and capabilities, remaining disciplined on transition assistance and advisor economics.
items.quote: we don't lead with the highest check. We want to have competitive economics. Certainly, we have to have competitive economics, but we lead with culture and capabilities... So we remain disciplined. We've always been disciplined on those transaction assistance -- transition assistance and economics to advisers.

items.text: The firm defines PCG recruiting and retention-related compensation as including cash and equity awards issued in conjunction with recruiting activities, as retention for existing advisors, or in conjunction with acquisitions, expensed over a requisite service period typically between 5 and 10 years.
items.quote: PCG recruiting and retention-related compensation includes expenses related to cash and equity awards issued in conjunction with recruiting activities, as retention for existing advisors, or in conjunction with our acquisitions... Such awards are expensed over the requisite service period (typically between 5 and 10 years).
items.definition: cash and equity awards issued in conjunction with recruiting activities, as retention for existing advisors, or in conjunction with acquisitions

items.text: Raymond James originates loans to financial advisors primarily as part of its recruiting activities.
items.quote: Loans to financial advisors are primarily comprised of loans originated as a part of our recruiting activities.

items.text: Raymond James emphasizes advisor book ownership as central to its employee advisor offering, describing 'your business. Your brand. Your clients.'
items.quote: Book ownership is just the beginning... We've redefined the employee advisor experience, enabled by advisor book ownership. It's your business. Your brand. Your clients.

items.text: Raymond James participates, with limited exceptions, in the Protocol for Broker Recruiting, which governs the client information financial advisors may take when affiliating with a new firm and their ability to solicit clients of their prior firm.
items.quote: We participate, with limited exceptions, in the Protocol for Broker Recruiting ("Protocol"), a voluntary agreement among many firms in the industry that governs, among other things, the client information that financial advisors may take with them when they affiliate with a new firm and the financial advisor's ability to solicit clients of their prior firm.

items.quote: 70-80% gross payout** and full array of competitive employee benefits offerings.

items.quote: 81% to 90% payout***. Leverage our third party partnerships to create a benefits package that best fits your team.

items.quote: Our competitive pay packages include base salary, incentive bonus, and equity compensation programs... we may grant equity awards in connection with initial employment or under various retention programs for individuals who are responsible for contributing to our management, growth, and/or profitability.
